TEL AVIV, Israel


, Nov. 6, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- SuperCom (NASDAQ:SPCB ), a global provider of secure solutions for the IoT, cybersecurity, and digital identity sectors, will hold a conference call on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 10 a.m. Eastern time (7 a.m. Pacific time / 5 p.m. Israel time) to discuss its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Financial results will be issued in a press release prior to the call.


SuperCom management will host the conference call, followed by a question-and-answer period.


**Conference Call Dial-In Information:**


**Date:** Thursday, November 12, 2026
**Time:** 10 a.m. Eastern time (7 a.m. Pacific time / 5 p.m. Israel time)
**U.S. toll-free:** 888-506-0062
**Israel toll-free:** 1-809-423-853
**International:** 973-528-0011
**Access Code:** SuperCom
**Webcast:**[https://www.webcaster5.com/Webcast/Page/2259/54778](https://www.webcaster5.com/Webcast/Page/2259/54778)


Please call the conference telephone number 5-10 minutes prior to the start time. An operator will register your name and organization.


**About SuperCom**


Founded in 1988, SuperCom (NASDAQ:SPCB ) is a global provider of IoT, cybersecurity, and digital identity solutions for governments and enterprises worldwide.


SuperCom's IoT solutions combine proprietary wearable devices, communications technology, and monitoring software to deliver real-time electronic monitoring for public safety. Its PureSecurity suite, including the PureOne GPS monitoring solution and the PureProtect domestic violence monitoring solution, is deployed in government programs across Europe and North America.


Through its wholly owned cybersecurity subsidiary Safend, SuperCom provides endpoint data protection, data loss prevention, encryption, and device and port control solutions, helping organizations protect sensitive information and prevent unauthorized data access and transfer. SuperCom has also introduced SafeGenie, a suite for the real-time monitoring and control of AI agents.


SuperCom also delivers e-Government solutions for secure identification, biometric enrollment, document issuance, and border control.


For more information, please visit[www.supercom.com](http://www.supercom.com/) .
